set.body:
Purpose and scope
Implement the specified family resolution in the appropriate portable bids4s layer and bind it through Sanctity interpretation. Do not duplicate portable association rules in the storage adapter. Preserve explicit grouped members, field origins and unresolved/ambiguous evidence; version the resolver/coverage contract rather than silently changing historical meaning.

Acceptance proof
The F1 matrix agrees with expected grouping and failures. Input order does not change identity. Cross-session declarations resolve without nearest-file guessing. Existing phasediff/EPI cases and historical interpretation decoding pass; changed companions produce changed evidence while unrelated artifacts remain stable.

Start here
sibling bids4s fieldmap resolver and portable tests, subject to its local instructions; modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/BidsInterpreter.scala; modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Science.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app/MriLifecycleSuite.scala

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: F2: Resolve phase1/phase2 families with exact member and origin evidence
